start: Signed in, on Today, on a phone

steps.action: Tap 'Members' on the bottom bar
user_sees: The Members page; only Members is lit on the bar
must_not: Two entries lit at once
Today still lit

steps.action: Tap 'More' on the bottom bar
user_sees: Rows in the side menu's order: 'Enquiries', 'Invite members', 'Plans', 'Shop', 'Trainers', 'Workout plans', 'Diet plans', 'Challenges', 'Staff & sign-in'
Also 'Expenses' and 'Your growth'
must_not: Members, Visits or Money repeated on More

steps.action: Tap 'Plans', then press back
user_sees: The Plans page, then More again
must_not: Back leaves the admin app or lands on Today

steps.action: Tap the round Refresh button at the top
user_sees: 'Refreshing…' while it runs, then the age, for example 'Updated 5 s ago'
must_not: A second read started by a second tap
The age not moving after a good refresh

steps.action: Click a row of the side menu, for example 'Enquiries'
user_sees: The page opens; that row is lit; a sub-page such as Branding lights its own row, not Settings
must_not: The page reloads whole or the wrong row is lit

steps.action: Open a member's page from the list
user_sees: 'Members' stays lit in the menu
must_not: No row lit at all

start: Signed in; a saved address or a link inside a page

steps.action: Open the app at an address such as #/members or tap a page link
user_sees: That page, with the menu lit to match; an old address is sent on to its new place
must_not: Back button trapped by a redirect
A blank page for an address with a trailing slash

steps.action: Tap Refresh
user_sees: 'Refreshing…', then 'Could not refresh. Check the internet and try again.' and a red ring with '!'
must_not: 'Updated just now' after a refresh that failed
The old figures wiped from the page

start: Signed in, a refresh has just failed

steps.action: Tap Refresh again with the internet back
user_sees: The red ring and '!' go; the age starts again from a few seconds
must_not: The failed words staying after a good refresh

steps.action: Leave the tab hidden for some minutes, come back
user_sees: The age shows the true time since the last read
must_not: The age frozen at the value from before the tab was hidden

start: Owner signed in on a shared desk computer

steps.action: Look at the menu and More
user_sees: Every row, with 'Expenses', 'Your growth' and money pages
must_not: none of these rows missing for the owner

steps.action: Sign out; a front-desk person signs in on the same computer
user_sees: Their menu has no 'Expenses', 'Your growth', 'Branding' or 'AI Assistant'
must_not: An owner row left in the menu from the owner's visit
An owner page still open behind the sign-in
